Mapagmahal St., Diliman Quezon City OFFICE OF THE UNDERSECRETARY Legal O i i n SANGGUNIANG BAYAN Kabasalan, Zamboanga Sibugay Gentlemen/Ladies: This pertains to the letter of Datu Wifredo Sanggayan regarding your Resolution No. 052-1215-2010 entitled: "A RESOLUTION INHIBITING HONORABLE ROSIANA L. ADAN FROM ASSUMING THE OFFICE OF THE IP REPRESENTATIVE IN THE SANGGUNIANG BAYAN EFFECTIVE January 01, 2011 PENDING RESOLUTION OF THE LEGITIMACY OF HER REPRESENTATION WITH THE INDIGENOUS PEOPLES IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE LOCAL GUIDELINES PURSUANT TO MEMORANDUM CIRCULAR 2010 NO. 2010-119 TO PROTECT THE MUNICIPAL GOVERNMENT OF KABASALAN, ZAMBOANGA SIBUGAY." Mr. Sanggayan is now requesting this Department to act on the matter. In this regard, please be informed that we find no cogent reason to deviate from our previous opinion. We reiterate our opinion in DILG no. 20 S. 2011 where we opined and we quote: In reply thereto, Republic Act 8317, otherwise known as the "lndgeneous Peoples Rights Act of 1991" was approved and signed into law on 29 October 1997. Said law provides that the Indigenous Cultural Communities/lndigenous Peoples (ICCs/IPs)) have the right to participate fully, if they so choose, at all levels of decision- making in matters which may affect their rights, lives and destinies through procedures determined by them as well as to maintain and develop their own indigenous political structures, Said law recognizes the policy of the State in affording the indigenous people communities adequate representations in the local sanggunians at all levels Precisely, pursuant to Section 6, Rule IV of the Implementing Rules and Regulations of RA 8371, it is mandated that the ICCs/lPs shall be provided mandat01)1 representation in all policy making bodies and in local sanggunians. ICCs/IPs representation shall be made proportionate to their population, and shall have the same privileges as the regular members of the local sanggunians and/or policy making bodies. On 28 October 2009, the NCIP again issued NCIP Administrative Order No. 001, series of 2009 prescribing national guidelines for the mandatory representation of Indigenous Peoples in the local sanggunians Section 11,12,13 and 16 of NCIP AO No. 001, series of 2009 provide and we quote:

"SECTION 11. Term ofand Removal from Office. The term of office of the IPs mandatory representative in the local legislative councils shall be for a period of three (3) years from the date of assumption to office and can be re-indorsed for another term by the ICCs/IPs constituents but in no case shall the representative serve for more than three (3) consecutive terms. For LGUs with more than one (1) ICCs/IPs residing within its jurisdiction, all ICCs/IPs tribes in said LGU may agree on a term-sharing agreements based on population ratio, or on whatever local arrangement they may deem suited and applicable to address the cultural peculiarities in that LGU. The IPs mandatory representative can be replaced anytime by the ICCs/IPs who selected him/her to the position in accordance with their local guidelines on recall/removal from office. " "SECTION 12. Selection and Assumption to Office. The selection of the particular ICC/IP representative to the local legislative council shall be in accordance with the Local Guideline that the concerned ICCs/IPs shall adopt and promulgate, which considers the cycle of traditional or local activities, and must be compliant to this Administrative Order by containing, at least, the following: k. l, m. n. o. p. q. r. s. t. Title; Definition of Terms; Selection process which should make a delineation of representation to the levels ofBarangay, Municipality, City and Province; Qualifications and Disqualifications; Community Confirmation and Nomination; Vacancy; Disciplinary Action; Term of Office; Recall/Removal; Special Provisions, if any; Amendment; and Effectivity Clause For the purpose of ensuring uniformity in the form of the Local Guidelines to be adopted by the concerned ICCs/IPs, the Office of Empowerment and Human Rights (OEHR) shall develop and make available a guide form. Assumption to Office shall take place as soon as the selection process is formally certified by the concerned NCIP Regional Directon u on recommendation o the Provincial or Communi Service Center head. as the case may be, to be in accordance with this Administrative Orden and the person chosen takes the appropriate oath before an authorized officer and inform the appropriate body/.ies of_ his/her assumption (Emphasis Supplied) "SECTION 13. Compensation and Benefits. Compensation: benefits and other emoluments of the IP representative shall be the same with that of the regular members of the concerned legislative bodies as prescribed in RA 7160 and other applicable laws. " (Emphasis Supplied)

"SECTION 16. Duties of the Regional Office. It shall be the task ofthe Regional Office to: c. d. Evaluate the documents and results of the proceedings; if found meritorious, it shall issue a Certificate of Affirmation (COA) to the selected representative. Otherwise, the same shall be returned to the recommending NCIP Field Office with specific instructionsfor compliance. Submit to DILG for recognition a copy of its issued COA of selected representative including all documents appurtenant thereto, copy furnished the NCIP Central Office through the Office of Empowerment and Human Rights (OEHR). " Clearly from the foregoing, the ICC/IP representative to the local sanggunian shall be selected in accordance with the Local Guideline duly adopted and promulgated by the ICCs/IPs themselves. After said ICC/IP representative was selected, the NCIP Regional Office shall issue a Certificate of Confirmation (COA), and on the basis of such confirmation, this Department shall thereafter accord due recognition to him/hen " Also, after evaluation of the documents attached to the letter of Datu Sanggayan it appears that Regional Director Abdul B. Puengan, of NCIP Region IX already issued a Certificate of Confirmation that Rosiana L. Adan was legally selected as the ICCs/IPs Representative in the Sangguniang Bayan of Kabasalan, Zamboanga Sibugay and shall hold office until October 29, 2012. Hence,we are of the view that the requirements enumerated in the above-cited NCIP Administrative Order has been complied with. Please note further, that the term of office of the IPs mandatory representative in the local legislative council shall be for a period of three (3) years from the date of assumption to office. Such being the case, it is our considered view that there is no legal impediment to the assumption of Rosiana L. Adan as the Indigenous Peoples Representative to the Sangguniang Bayan of Kabasalan, Zamboanga Sigubay. Finally, you are also advised to revisit your Resolution No. 052-1215-2010 and if the circumstances so warrant, to repeal or amend the aforesaid legislative measure to avoid administrative charges that will be filed against you in the future. Please be guided accordingly. Very t ly yours, AUSTERE A. PANADERO Undersecretary LS:94/11 Datu Wilfredo Sanggayan Office of the Provincial Indigenous People's Representative Kabasahan, Zamboanga Sigubay
